intro: Measured on one machine (Windows 11, Intel 13900K, RTX 4090) against a retail Xbox Series 1.0.2.1 package. Every row below is an outcome the project produces, not a plan; the commands that produce them are in the Build section, and the failures behind each number are in docs/boot_frontier.md.

stages.evidence: the title's PE32+ image maps at its preferred base, imports resolve through shims, static TLS is redirected for 53,246 slot-0 reads, heap and file system come from the host
26,616 SPIR-V modules indexed; the boot loads 27,890 translated entries with 0 pipeline failures

device, queues, fences, allocators, descriptor heaps and command lists answer; the console queue's two-method slot shift, the fence completed-value address, the command-list lifecycle and the clear/barrier conversions are measured and mapped
factory, file open, zlib decompression; BCPack and swizzled reads still refuse rather than guess
the title boots and runs its own loop for the full timeout with no exception
the frame records, closes and submits: 88,128 Close calls succeed with 0 failed, ~43,750 frames submitted per 150 s run, console queue slot 35 is wired as the submit
all 10,241 slot-57 graphics records build into real PC pipelines (0 refusals) after the input-layout element table was decoded; fixed-function state and attachments are still documented stand-ins
42,721 SetPipelineState and 42,722 DrawInstanced recorded per 150 s boot

every draw-carrying submit is refused on an unrebased title VA; registering the placed-buffer stand-in under its console VA makes the draws execute and TDRs the GPU, because translated shaders compute host_address = heap_base + console_va (docs/replay_resolution.md)
the title writes a null resource into its own display-surface record every frame, so present calls name nothing; the presentation core is prepared for wiring (docs/display_path.md)
no draw-carrying submit executes yet, so nothing can be drawn

counts.value: ALIVE the full timeout, no exception

counts.what: Graphics pipelines built from slot-57 records

counts.value: draws execute with the console-VA registration, then GPU TDR

frontier.stop: none - the title runs, records and submits; every draw-carrying submit is refused on an unrebased title VA
frontier.summary: the title boots, runs, records frames, builds all 10,241 graphics pipelines and records 42,722 draws per 150 s run. The open frontier is the GPU address space: draws bind vertex buffers by the title's two-terabyte page VAs, and making one execute (by registering the placed-buffer stand-in under its console VA) TDRs the GPU because translated shaders compute host_address = heap_base + console_va - the page VAs must be put into the single GPU address space. Presentation is separately blocked on the title writing a null display surface.

next: put the title's page VAs into the GPU address space (arena range at creation + VA rebasing) so a draw executes without a TDR
import the title's placed pages (their writes are not visible to the GPU today)
name the creator of the null display surfaces and give them a real resource
fix console device slot 55 (forwarded to PC CreateReservedResource1; 41,545 failures per 120 s)
decode the slot-57 fixed-function state blob (rasterizer/blend/depth/topology/sample and attachments are stand-ins)
wire PresentX once the present names a real resource
